rv.q: This production is most enjoyable as a whole—because of all the talent onstage, because of all the enthusiasm shown by every single member of the cast, and because of all the hard work that has obviously been put into the show by everyone involved with Music Theater Works.
This 21st century retelling of Stephen Schwartz’s hit musical from the 1970’s is dynamic and exciting.
Its playfulness is a nice summer escape!
With his strong voice and just the right touch, Ripperger plays Pippin to perfection and neatly carries the entire show.

cn.t: Music Theater Works delivers a visually eclectic, wacky take on "Pippin" that critics find entertaining and engaging. The production's pop culture-infused design and playful energy earn solid praise across the board.
